architectureDecisions: The canonical graph routes exactly RESEARCH_SA and WORKER; EXECUTION, JUDGMENT, REPAIR and MERGE_PENDING are phases.

The lane contract is explicit: RESEARCH_SA input is the bound OBJECTIVE and output is a READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN; WORKER input is the exact READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN binding and output is a DELIVERED_FEATURE receipt.
OBJECTIVE and plan are bound by canonical ref and content hash. Plan hashing excludes only status/readiness receipt. Current artifacts are updated in place without history chains.
Jev replaces semantic judgment. Deterministic validators enforce bindings, claim coverage, successful evidence and delivery identity. Confidence is telemetry only.
Use native Node fetch with the pinned jev-1.13.0 model and one batch of independent Choice questions. Missing evidence and malformed output cannot become SATISFIED.
Cache normalized state/spec/model/policy hashes including source and evidence contents. Reuse valid findings, never reroll unchanged input for pass.
Use a separate trusted CI evaluator job with TYPESAFE_API_KEY; candidate verification runs in a job without that key. Canonical publication remains a trusted-controller command.
Preserve candidate commit identity. Require candidate ancestry on main, exact merge tree, and evaluated source still present at delivery observation.
Retain terminal canonical artifacts unchanged. Convert unfinished tasks to new objective/plan drafts, without retroactive acceptance.

The migration is current-only: unfinished legacy inputs are normalized in place, while terminal evidence is co-located beside the current plan with an explicit suffix and never becomes routing authority.

laneContracts.convergence: Jev returns SATISFIED for every objective and readiness question; plan status becomes READY and readinessRef binds that evaluation

laneContracts.input: exact READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN ref plus content hash
laneContracts.binding: task.contract.planRef plus plan hash, candidate SHA/tree, evidence hash and merge SHA
laneContracts.convergence: implementation evidence, Jev candidate judgment and exact merge identity are all satisfied
forbidden: edit or redefine the bound objective/plan

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Research converges only with an implementable plan and SATISFIED readiness claims
Worker converges only when every acceptance claim is SATISFIED and the exact candidate exists in main
Normal verification never calls live Jev

deliveryContract.readiness: RESEARCH_SA publishes a JEV_EVALUATION only after materializing the bound objective and plan; SATISFIED changes plan.status to READY and moves the task to WORKER/EXECUTION.
deliveryContract.worker: WORKER publishes implementation evidence without a verdict; Jev evaluates every acceptance criterion from exact candidate evidence and only SATISFIED advances to MERGE_PENDING.
deliveryContract.delivery: The trusted controller verifies candidate ancestry, exact merge tree, unchanged evaluated sources and consolidated refs before writing DELIVERED_FEATURE.

ciContract.verificationJob: Runs declared candidate verification with TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent and uploads immutable evidence.
ciContract.evaluationJob: Reads the candidate/evidence bundle as data, uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY for one Jev request, validates the typed result and uploads the evaluation artifact.
ciContract.publication: A trusted controller publishes only an evaluation whose plan, candidate, evidence and merge bindings match the current Board.

cacheContract.rule: Reuse valid findings and SATISFIED answers only for the unchanged semantic input; never cache transport or schema errors.

migrationContract.unfinished: Normalize legacy unfinished inputs to the current objective/plan pair and rewrite graph bindings to unsuffixed current refs.
migrationContract.terminal: Keep terminal implementation-result and judgment evidence beside the plan with explicit suffixes; migration is idempotent and never changes their contents.

readinessProof.rule: Readiness is a plan judgment. The plan's explicit contract, coverage, source seams, slice outputs and verification matrix establish implementability now; worker logs and merge receipts are deliberately deferred to WORKER.

implementationSlices: Slice 1 — binding contracts: extend scripts/blackboard-delivery-contract.mjs and scripts/blackboard-work-graph.mjs so the graph exposes only RESEARCH_SA and WORKER, phase transitions are constrained, objective/plan/evidence refs are content-hashed, and a worker cannot rewrite upstream JSON; add negative tests for a third lane, same-ref edits and producer verdict fields.

Slice 2 — Jev evaluator: implement scripts/blackboard-jev.mjs and scripts/blackboard-jev-cli.mjs to materialize one bounded {model,state,questions} batch, ask one atomic Choice per objective/readiness or worker criterion, validate exact IDs/types/probabilities/model/usage, classify all-non-SATISFIED answers, cache by state/spec/model/policy/lane hash, record attempts/latency/tokens/cost, and fail closed on missing key/schema/transport errors.

Slice 3 — research readiness: add explicit RESEARCH_SA -> READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN publication in scripts/blackboard-delivery.mjs, bind readiness to the current plan hash, require objective coverage, source seams, criterion-specific verification and negative cases, and route PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION or missing evidence back to RESEARCH without changing the objective.

Slice 4 — context and migration: update scripts/blackboard-task-context-resolver.mjs, scripts/blackboard-context-verify.mjs and scripts/blackboard-delivery-migrate.mjs to resolve only current graph pointers, normalize unfinished legacy directories into docs/blackboard/artifacts/objective/ and docs/blackboard/artifacts/ready-implement-plan/, reject legacy routing paths and retain terminal evidence beside the plan unchanged.

Slice 5 — worker and delivery: implement scripts/blackboard-delivery-context.mjs, scripts/blackboard-delivery-verify.mjs and scripts/blackboard-delivery.mjs so WORKER consumes the exact READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN, runs declared verification without TYPESAFE_API_KEY, binds candidate/evidence hashes, evaluates every acceptance claim, requires candidate ancestry and exact merge tree, and writes DELIVERED_FEATURE only after main verification.

Slice 6 — CI and documentation: add .github/workflows/blackboard-jev.yml with separate keyless verification and keyed evaluation jobs, upload a typed Jev artifact without running candidate code under the key, wire package scripts, document the two-lane input/output contract and local .env setup, and keep live evaluation/stability out of normal npm run verify.
negativeVerificationCases: A third lane or a phase value cannot make a task schedulable.
A worker cannot modify the bound objective or ready plan at the same path.
A producer implementation result cannot contain a verdict or acceptance claim.
Missing API credentials, malformed Jev answers, model mismatch and stale bindings cannot publish SATISFIED.
Unchanged semantic input reuses cache; changed objective, plan, evidence or candidate invalidates it.
A legacy artifact directory is rejected and migration is idempotent.
Candidate verification fails when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is present or when the candidate tree is not the evaluated tree.
A delivery receipt cannot be published without an accepted evaluation and exact merge identity.
